'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] recapture [[Khreshchenivka]] as they continue to advance southwards in the [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian-occupied]] [[Kherson Oblast]], with [[Russia]]'s [[49th Combined Arms Army]] reportedly withdrawing some troops from the frontline to [[Beryslav]]. *[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A taxi driver is shot and wounded by [[Palestinian]] militants near [[Elon Moreh]] in the [[West Bank]]. A demonstration by local [[Israeli settlers]] to protest the incident is attacked with gunfire, wounding a soldier. Palestinian militant group [[Lions' Den (militant group)|Lion's Den]] claims responsibility for the incident. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/gunmen-target-taxi-bus-in-west-bank-suspected-terror-attack-1-lightly-injured/ (''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/soldier-lightly-hurt-in-west-bank-shooting-after-earlier-attack-nearby/ (''Times of Israel 2'')]
*[[September 2022 Armenia–Azerbaijan clashes]]
**A video emerges showing [[Azerbaijani Armed Forces|Azerbaijani soldiers]] [[Extrajudicial killing|executing]] unarmed [[Armed Forces of Armenia|Armenian]] [[prisoners of war]] during clashes between [[Azerbaijan]] and [[Armenia]] last month. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3194609/armenian-eu-envoy-demands-answers-over-alleged (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**A mass grave of 42 people is found in [[Sirte]], [[Libya]], after arrested [[Islamic State]] militants tip off authorities. [https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-group-nato-middle-east-africa-libya-b84251ddb5d46742a75d660c2c48f2a4 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The death from [[Hurricane Ian]] rises to 87. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna50348 (NBC News)]
*Twenty-six people are killed and ten others are injured when a tractor pulling a wagon with around 40 people on board overturns into a pond in [[Kanpur]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-accidents-modi-drownings-kanpur-a4157d3417a2fafedf5c811c7042e07d (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Haiti]]an authorities announce an unexpected resurgence of [[cholera]] in the country and report that at least seven people have died from the disease. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/haiti-confirms-case-cholera-is-investigating-suspect-cases-2022-10-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**A stand-off ensues between students, protesters, and [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] forces in and around the [[Sharif University of Technology|Sharif University]] of [[Tehran]], as gunfire is reported amid an apparent siege of the building. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-63111767 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Annexation of Southern and Eastern Ukraine]]
***The [[Constitutional Court of Russia]] says that the annexation is [[Constitution of Russia|constitutional]], citing the need to correct the "arbitrary decisions of the [[USSR|Soviet]] government" and to prevent the claimed widespread repression of the [[Russians in Ukraine]]. It was later also clarified that the borders of the annexed subjects are intended to be those at the time of annexation. [https://www.rbc.ru/politics/02/10/2022/633962979a794778ecdb0986 (RBC Russia)]
*[[2022 Brazilian general election]]
**[[Brazilians]] head to the polls to elect their [[President of Brazil|president]], [[Vice President of Brazil|vice president]], and [[National Congress of Brazil|National Congress]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/brazil-holds-historic-election-with-lula-against-bolsonaro/2022/10/02/566bb5be-4207-11ed-8c6e-9386bd7cd826_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**Incumbent president [[Jair Bolsonaro]] and former president [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] will face off in a runoff election on October 30. Lula obtained 48.3% of the vote, Bolsonaro 43.3%. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/brazil-holds-historic-election-with-lula-against-bolsonaro/2022/10/02/566bb5be-4207-11ed-8c6e-9386bd7cd826_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2022 Bulgarian parliamentary election]]
**[[Bulgarians]] head to the polls for the fourth time in 18 months to elect members of the [[National Assembly (Bulgaria)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/2/voting-begins-in-bulgaria-elections (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 Bosnian general election]]
**[[Bosnians]] head to the polls to elect the three members of their ethnically shared government. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-elections-voting-general-d0337059c21f4371745751c980dc825a?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=voting-begins-in-bosnia-election-little-expected-to-change (AP)]

**[[Sergio Pérez]] wins the [[Formula 1|F1]] [[Singapore Grand Prix|Singapore GP]] as his [[Red Bull Racing|teammate]] [[Max Verstappen]] missed the chance to win the championship. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/02/sergio-perez-wins-singapore-f1-gp-as-max-verstappen-forced-to-wait-for-title (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2022 London Marathon]]
**[[Yalemzerf Yehualaw]] of [[Ethiopia]] becomes the youngest woman to win the [[London Marathon]] while [[Amos Kipruto]] of [[Kenya]] wins the men's race. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/02/london-marathon-yalemzerf-yehualaw-youngest-winner-amos-kipruto (''The Guardian'')]
*In [[horse racing]], [[Alpinista]] wins the [[Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe]] in [[Paris, France]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/02/alpinista-wins-emotional-prix-de-larc-de-triomphe-for-sir-mark-prescott-horse-racing (''The Guardian'')]
